subject: Fatal outcome following Renalix therapy - urgent
body_text:
Pharmacovigilance,

I am reporting a fatal case. An 84-year-old male patient with chronic kidney disease stage 4 was started on Renalix 10 mg orally daily on 18 December 2025.

On 05 January 2026 he was admitted with severe hyperkalaemia and cardiac arrhythmia. Despite treatment he died on 07 January 2026. The treating team considers the event possibly related to Renalix.

Dr Sofia Marchetti
Ospedale Centrale, Milan, Italy
